params.message:
Posts keep their Signal heading; the teaser counts a glued heading apart

The repeat strip dropped any leading H1 or H2 and any italic line after it, to
avoid printing the title and standfirst twice. Every post opens with its
"## Signal" section, so every post lost that heading. It now drops a leading
heading only when it is the title, and an italic line only when it is the dek.

The teaser split the body at blank lines only, so a heading written with its
text on the next line was one paragraph starting with "#": kept whole and not
counted against the budget, which let that text through to readers the post
is locked for. It now counts the blocks the page renders, a heading line on
its own wherever it stands.
